name: Food Tech
old_description: Food Tech specializes in the planning/ engineering/construction of food process plants and cold storage facilities.
about:
Food Tech, based in Rockland, Massachusetts, operates as a design-build firm specializing in food processing plants and cold storage facilities. The company is a subsidiary of EMCOR Group, Inc., a Fortune 500 mechanical and electrical construction leader. Bob Ross, P.E., serves as president.

The firm provides end-to-end services including facility planning, preconstruction, architecture, engineering, and construction management. It does not self-perform construction, instead managing competitive bidding among subcontractors. A notable project is a 190,000-square-foot cheese production facility capable of processing two million pounds of milk per day, featuring robotic packing and palletizing.

Food Tech serves dairy, fresh food, frozen food, USDA meat plants, and cold storage sectors. Its clients range from large publicly traded companies to smaller regional processors, distributors, retailers, and wholesalers. Offices in Boston and Milwaukee support a national footprint.

The company differentiates itself through a single-source design-build model that delivers a guaranteed maximum price early, returns savings from competitive bids, and maintains in-house architecture and engineering. Its safety program is described as award-winning and industry-leading.
